description:
Orthologues of a gene from Ensembl Plants Compara (gene trees across plant genomes), e.g. the Brassica copies
of an Arabidopsis gene. gene: Ensembl ID or name; target_species: Ensembl name to restrict to (e.g.
'medicago_truncatula' or 'pisum_sativum'). Returns orthologue IDs, species, relationship (one2one, one2many, many2many).
name: orthologues
